Documents explaining the 1970s US stagflation, and the documents they cite

Source: R/Nodes_stagflation.R
Nodes_stagflation.Rd

The corpus of Goutsmedt (2021) : the 174 books and academic articles that tried to explain the US stagflation of the 1970s, published from 1975 to 2013 (source_type == "Stagflation"), and the 480 documents cited at least twice by them ("Non-Stagflation"). With Ref_stagflation, it is the example data of the package: the explanations are the nodes of a bibliographic coupling network, linked by the references they share.

Usage

Nodes_stagflation

Format

A data frame with 654 rows and 7 variables:

source_id

Identifier of the document.

source_author

First author of the document (see Authors_stagflation for all authors).

source_label

Short label (author and year), for plots.

source_year

Year of publication, as a character string.

source_title

Title of the document.

source_journal

Journal of publication, for articles.

source_type

"Stagflation" for the documents explaining the stagflation, "Non-Stagflation" for the documents they cite.

Source

Goutsmedt (2021) .

References

Goutsmedt A (2021). “From the Stagflation to the Great Inflation: Explaining the US Economy of the 1970s.” Revue d'Économie Politique, 131(3), 557–582. https://www.cairn.info/revue-d-economie-politique-2021-3-page-557.htm.
